summary: Comcast Corp filed an 8-K announcing plans to separate its media and technology businesses into two independent public companies: NBCUniversal (premier global media and entertainment with theme parks, film, TV, streaming) and Comcast (broadband/connectivity technology). The transaction is structured as a tax-free spin-off to shareholders. No specific price, premium, or timeline is stated; no advisor or board recommendation is detailed. Watch for shareholder approval, regulatory clearances, and IRS ruling on tax-free treatment; risk-arb will focus on relative valuation splits and potential activist interest post-separation.
